when.vo_deadpool: When the title screen appears in attract mode.
when.vo_player1: When it becomes Player 1’s turn in a multiplayer game.
when.vo_player2: When it becomes Player 2’s turn in a multiplayer game.
when.vo_player3: When it becomes Player 3’s turn in a multiplayer game.
when.vo_player4: When it becomes Player 4’s turn in a multiplayer game.
when.vo_useflipperselecttoplaneskillshot: While the ball is waiting at the plunger, during the skill-shot selection tip.
when.vo_holdflipper-sk: While the ball is waiting at the plunger, during the super skill-shot tip.
when.vo_whatareyouwaitingfor: When the ball sits at the plunger and the game prompts you to launch it.
when.vo_ballsaved: When the ball drains while ball save is active.
when.vo_chooseyourbattle: When you shoot the lit scoop and the party task picker opens.
when.vo_juggernaut: When Wrap the Presents is highlighted in the party task picker.
when.vo_mystique: When Send the Invitations is highlighted in the party task picker.
when.vo_sabretooth: When Blow Up the Balloons is highlighted in the party task picker.
when.vo_shoot-mystique: When Send the Invitations starts and the game tells you where to shoot.
when.vo_shoot-sabretooth: When Blow Up the Balloons starts and the game tells you where to shoot.
when.vo_lildp3: Randomly selected on a Finni toy hit before you’ve made enough hits to start Cake Time.
when.vo_lildp5: Randomly selected on a Finni toy hit before you’ve made enough hits to start Cake Time.
when.vo_lildp6: Randomly selected on a Finni toy hit before you’ve made enough hits to start Cake Time.

when.vo_completetoplanes: The first time the game prompts you to finish the top lanes for a bonus multiplier.
when.vo_completedeadtargets: After you hit two of the four left targets, if the task scoop isn’t already lit.
when.vo_completepool-lock: After you hit two of the four right targets, if the right-ramp lock isn’t already lit.
when.vo_battleislit: When you clear the left target bank and the scoop lights to pick a task.
when.vo_completedptargets-mystery: Shortly after you clear either the left or right target bank for the first time.
when.vo_lockislit: When you clear the right target bank or Mystery lights the right-ramp lock.
when.vo_ball1locked: When you lock ball 1 for Friendship Multiball.
when.vo_mysteryislit: When you’ve cleared both target banks and Mystery lights at the scoop.
when.vo_combo: On the second shot in a combo chain.
when.vo_2xcombo: On shot 3 in a combo chain.
when.vo_supercombo: On the seventh combo shot, or when the left loop feeds directly into the right ramp for the confetti bonus.
when.vo_dazzlerteamup: When four upward left-loop shots earn the Kitchen Timer outside a party task.
when.vo_colossusteamup: When four shots through the Party Lights loop earn the upgrade outside a party task.
when.vo_wolverineteamup: When four center-loop shots earn the Checklist outside a party task.
when.vo_dominoteamup: When four right-loop shots earn Party Favors outside a party task, excluding skill shots.
when.vo_boombuttonisready: When you hit all four action-button targets and the button lights.
when.vo_boom: When you activate the lit action button.
when.vo_lildp_multiball2: When enough Mini Finni hits start Cake Time Multiball.
when.vo_lildp_multibal: When the timed Cake Time jackpot counts down to 250,000 points.
when.vo_lildp_timeup: When the timed Cake Time jackpot runs down or the mode ends while its timer is active.
when.vo_ball2locked: When you lock ball 2 for Friendship Multiball.
when.vo_ball3locked: When you lock ball 3 for Friendship Multiball.
when.vo_friendshipmb: When the third friend is locked and Friendship Multiball starts.
when.vo_lildp_jackpot1: Random variant 1 of four for a jackpot during Cake Time Multiball.
when.vo_lildp_jackpot2: Random variant 2 of four for a jackpot during Cake Time Multiball.
when.vo_lildp_jackpot3: Random variant 3 of four for a jackpot during Cake Time Multiball.
when.vo_lildp_jackpot4: Random variant 4 of four for a jackpot during Cake Time Multiball.
when.vo_jackpot: When you score a regular jackpot outside Cake Time, including during Streamer Rush.
when.vo_juggernautdefeated: When you complete Wrap the Presents.
when.vo_mystiquedefeated: When you complete Send the Invitations.
when.vo_sabretoothdefeated: When you complete Blow Up the Balloons.
when.vo_shootthescoop: When you finish a party task and the scoop lights for an extra jackpot.
when.vo_3xcombo: On shot 4 in a combo chain.
when.vo_completedptargets-regenerate: Shortly after you clear either the left or right target bank for the second time.
when.vo_extraballislit: When Mystery awards a lit extra ball at the scoop.

when.vo_caketimetoppings: When the initial Finni jackpots are collected and Cake Time moves to the lit shots.
when.vo_caketimefinish: When the lit-shot phase ends and the timed spinner phase begins in Cake Time.
when.vo_caketimefrosting: When the Cake Time spinner timer ends and the mode sends you back to Finni.
when.vo_discoloops: When the left spinner reaches 50 spins for Disco Loops or 100 for Disco Multiball.
when.vo_katanaramaisready: When you collect the sixth ribbon and start Streamer Rush.
when.vo_trex: When Put Up the Decorations is highlighted in the party task picker.
when.vo_megalodon: When Bake the Cookies is highlighted in the party task picker.
when.vo_shootblueshots-megalodon: When Bake the Cookies starts and the game tells you where to shoot.
when.vo_sauron: When Hang the Piñata is highlighted in the party task picker.
when.vo_shootgreenshots-trex: When Put Up the Decorations starts and the game tells you where to shoot.
when.vo_shootgreenshots-sauron: When Hang the Piñata starts and the game tells you where to shoot.
when.vo_shootflashingshots: When Wrap the Presents starts and the game tells you where to shoot.
when.vo_shootflashingshots-ifyoudare: When Party Time starts and the game tells you where to shoot.
when.vo_trexdefeated: When you complete Put Up the Decorations.
when.vo_megalodondefeated: When you complete Bake the Cookies.
when.vo_saurondefeated: When you complete Hang the Piñata.
when.vo_4xcombo: On shot 5 in a combo chain.
when.vo_5xcombo: On shot 6 in a combo chain.
when.vo_shootscoop-extraball: Every 30 supplies collected, when an extra ball lights at the scoop.
when.vo_mrsinister: When Party Time is highlighted in the party task picker.
when.vo_superjackpot: When you score a super jackpot, including the Cookie Super Jackpot.
when.vo_lildp_xtraball: Every 50 confetti collected, when an extra ball lights at the scoop.
when.vo_regenerateislit: After you clear both the left and right target banks at least three times each.
when.vo_multiball: When you start Supply Run Multiball at the scoop after collecting 75 supplies.
when.vo_superdupercombo: On the eighth and each later shot in a combo chain.
when.vo_enterinitials: When a qualifying score opens the table’s initials entry.
